notes: Annual totals sourced from NCRB 'Crime in India' Volume I (Book 1), Table 1B.4 'IPC Crimes (Crime Head-wise & City-wise)' for years 2019-2023. Category mapping (NCRB Table 1B.4 column references): theft = Theft Total (col 263); robbery = Robbery Sec.392/394/397 (col 284) + Attempt Dacoity/Robbery Sec.393 & 398 (col 287) + Dacoity Total (col 290); assault = Murder Sec.302 (col 3) + Culpable Homicide not Murder Sec.304 (col 6) + Dowry Deaths Sec.304-B (col 33) + Attempt Murder Sec.307 (col 39) + Attempt Culpable Homicide Sec.308 (col 42) + Hurt Total (Simple+Grievous) (col 51); sexual_offence = Rape Sec.376 (col 174) + Attempt Rape Sec.376/511 (col 177) + Unnatural Offences Sec.377 (col 180); harassment = Assault on Women with Intent to Outrage Modesty Total Sec.354 (col 99) + Insult to Modesty Sec.509 (col 413); kidnapping = Kidnapping & Abduction Total (col 129); burglary = Burglary Total (col 272); other = Total Cognizable IPC (col 422) - sum of the above (residual includes Causing Death by Negligence 304-A, Riots, Forgery/Cheating/Fraud, Cruelty by Husband 498A, Arson, and other Misc IPC heads). Figures are 'Incidences/Cases' (I column), not victim counts. NCRB notes that cross-year comparisons of 'Theft' and 'Other Thefts' may be affected by some states (e.g. Delhi, UP, Tamil Nadu) introducing online-FIR registration which lowers/raises reported counts. Bengaluru row in NCRB covers only Bengaluru City Police commissionerate (not surrounding districts).
